description: Angular component for configuring related entities aggregation in the Thingsboard UI, including form controls, validation, and interaction logic.

classes.name: RelatedEntitiesAggregationComponentComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor and Validator for related entities aggregation configuration.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form configuration, returns validation errors or null.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Patches the form with a new configuration value.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback for when the form value changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers a callback for when the form is touched.

methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls.
